name: Shadowbound
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance, Shadowbound Creature (pg. 213), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=690
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance is ORC licensed material.
rules: Best at 3rd level or higher. Increase its level by 1; attacks, AC, saves, Perception, DCs and skills by 1; Strike damage by 1 (HP unchanged). Adds the shadow trait (loses holy), Shadowtongue, darkvision, immunities, physical resistance, Light Vulnerability, Shadow Form and Shadow Touch.
optional: Shadowtongue only if it can speak (added only to a creature with languages).

abilities.name: Light Vulnerability
abilities.description: Attacks against {name} are treated as magical if made by a creature that's in magical light or with an object that's in magical light (such as from the light spell).

abilities.name: Shadow Form
abilities.description: {Name} assumes a shadowy form. In this state, it gains the incorporeal trait. It has resistance 10 to all damage (except force, _ghost touch_, spirit, or vitality; double resistance vs. non-magical), is immune to precision damage, and can't use any actions with the attack or manipulate trait. It has a fly Speed of 15 feet and can slip through tiny cracks. {Name} can Dismiss this effect to become solid again, but if it does so in an area of bright light, it's stunned 1 for 1 round.

abilities.name: Shadow Touch
abilities.description: {Name}'s Strikes affect incorporeal creatures with the effects of a _ghost touch_ property rune.
